name: Perfect Consultation No Recommendation Needed - Asem

messages.text: Good morning. I need lights for a bedroom and study desk.
Good morning! I can help. For the bedroom, do you prefer cozy warm light or brighter neutral light?
Cozy warm light. But for the desk I need something bright for studying.
Great. I suggest 2700K warm light for bedroom comfort and 4000K neutral light for studying because it is bright but not too harsh.
For a medium bedroom, 12W to 15W LED usually works well. For a desk lamp, 7W to 9W LED is enough if the lamp is close to your books.
I have E27 sockets. Do you have these available?
Yes, E27 15W 2700K for bedroom and E27 9W 4000K for desk are available now.
Yes. Both are LED, so they use less electricity and last longer than old incandescent or fluorescent bulbs.
Can you reserve them for pickup?
Of course. I reserved one bedroom bulb and one desk bulb under your name. You can pick them up today until 20:00.
Thank you, this was very clear.
You are welcome! If you bring a photo of the lamp, I can also double-check the socket before payment.
